description: Searches the user's live Lingard account: vocabulary, learning context, English profile, totals, collection titles, saved words, flashcards, and missing vocabulary fields. Results are read from Firestore at the time of the call.

query.description: Search query, for example "English learning context" or "saved vocabulary collections".

targetLang.description: Lingard target language code such as en, de, es, fr, it, pl, or pt. Defaults to en when the prompt asks about English.

name: search
title: Search Lingard Vocab
